Todd, saw Nextech is scaling under TPG's $1.4B acquisition and just shipped the AI Cora Scribe.

Growth like that usually means more in-market practices than a region can cover before signal goes stale, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nextech off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Todd, quick follow-up for Nextech.

Under new ownership, regional targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most regional leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Todd, last bit of proof for Nextech.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire reps fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nextech's reply rate likely compares to similar software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
